text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and meet the criteria specified in the Notice by the Ministry of Education of Regulating Admission of International Students to China's Higher Education Institutions (Letter No.12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education), physically and mentally healthy, friendly to China and have no criminal record. 2. Applicants should possess at minimum a high school diploma or equivalent qualification. 3. Language proficiency requirements: English-taught majors: Applicants whose native language is English are exempt from providing English language proficiency certificates. Applicants whose native language is not English must provide proof of English language proficiency with the results of IELTS (6.0 or above), TOEFL (80 points or above), MyBest Scores (80 points or above), Essentials test (8 points or above), or other equivalent English language proficiency certificates (Duolingo English Test 90 points or above, CEFR-B2 or above, etc.). Applicants whose native language is not English but have received their highest level of education taught in English are exempt from providing IELTS / TOEFL certificates and other proof of English proficiency, but must submit proof of the language of instruction.
